items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Buddy and Zeb used to be right together all the time. They could sit down and get the stuff together.

ctx.x: Would he let the clang out take the lead much on other tunes?

Yeah, no, not very. Yeah, but the other tune that he couldn't, thought he wasn't going to get up to, you know. No. Something like, uh, like when the thing come out and Palermo Rag and that run. Well, he'd play down and Zeb, the clang that played would play it up. He'd play it up. See, he'd play it up. He'd play it up. But Zeb, he'd play it up. See, and it sounds good too. Yeah. Sounds good. He never was a high note fella, but he could play a nice horn. Oh, what's the matter? Now, it's a tumble. Gas. All in there.…
Well, you want to take some medicine, let us know.
